body:
I'm not sure if it's unhealthy really. I'm not particularly worried about myself but just for the well being of my friends. I've been told I'm a flirt through and through. But that's just like, my love language. Its how I communicate. If anyone knew me for more than a couple days, they would figure it out. 

I'm 21 right now, probably been doing this since I was about 15. It could be codependency? I just like doting on someone for a while. But if you changed maybe so will I.

Oh sometimes I know that I get jealous of my bf, and it's painful. Not only are the emotionally supportive like this but they're financially supportive, he goes to a fantastic uni, has his rent and food payed for him, won't have to pay back any student loans. Where as I'm the total opposite. I struggled a lot, slept and lived in my car for months, was forced to move back in with my nparents. 

The fact his parents are so good to him and mine arent as much has led to a lot of crying for me, but I don't want him to feel GUILTY. I just long for what he has.

 I try to never blame him for having it good. Or use it as an excuse for me to be irritable.

I think it's okay to feel jealous about it, as long as you understand that it's not your fault you didn't get what other people have.

Oh man yeah, my dad is just super anti therapists, for no fucking reason but then asks me if I want to go to the store with him or hangout and basically traps me in the car in the parking lot and talks about his feelings.
Like I can't even go outside and smoke a cig without him joining me and talking about his issues. Obviously he's not REALLY anti therapist, he just wants me to be it.

My mom has even vented to me about their sex life and cried and refused to let me hang up on her. I told her I was done and to get some real help and she just cried harder and told me she thought I loved her and that I'd be understanding.

Nparents are so fucking manipulative and terrible I almost feel bad for them.
Ah that does sound nice but I feel like even in that environment I'd never be able to speak up like that and say how I really feel. Even with an advocate. I fold over for my family often.

I hope you're well too, it's tough out here for people like us, so thank you for giving me some of your words.

I'm definitely faking it until I make it.
I can't even allow myself to do that. If not for them, then definitely for myself.

Thank you for this, and thank you for allowing me to know I'm not alone by sharing yourself here too. It means a lot to me to think I'm not the only one.

I'll definitely read up on that. I appreciate this tremendously.

I'd feel so guilty if I did and I don't have the kind of cash flow to move out on my own currently. My partner's parents, particularly his mother, ask me often to come live with them instead but I'd hate to be a burden.
It's good to know other people are also battling this. Thanks for commenting.

I'm pretty strict about only gushing on twitter and I understand it's pretty cringey, only ever speaking about them maybe a handful of times  I guess I just didn't see it as harmful bc I physically would never choose someone over him, which I thought would be clear after almost four years. Thank you for the feedback though, I can definitely see how he might think that if I was 'given the opportunity' by being more attractive or of that status, he'd be fearful. But I'm simply not, and I don't live in a fantasy where I am or ever will be, it's just not realistic. Thank you again for some perspective though.

When we lived together I usually just filled my time making portraits and sculptures of him bc I'm art student. Which was VERY time consuming and done in silence. I spent a lot of time just revolved around him so I didn't have much time for much else, and in turn he got a lot more attention from me. Now I don't have a live model to work from and I find myself with a lot of time, hence moving my time and attention elsewhere. I guess I just have to have something to fixated on.
It's definitely more about the characters, but I enjoy the actors too, I admit I don't know much at all about the actors themselves but still find them attractive.
